jobs.title: GET /api/kinds: a Storage.get_distinct_kinds(since) query (sorted, de-duplicated, non-archived, json_valid-guarded, NULL/empty kind excluded -- mirrors the TUI's GetDistinctKinds in tui/internal/db/queries.go:581-611 but scoped to non-archived only) wired into a new authenticated endpoint that accepts the same optional since_hours convenience parameter /api/entries takes, returns an empty list (not an error) when nothing matches, and is documented in API.md alongside the other /api/* endpoints

Web UI kind badge and filter: item cards render a lower-case kind badge from item.kind when present; a kind <select> populated from GET /api/kinds' response with an all-kinds default; choosing a kind adds kind=<kind> to the /api/entries request instead of filtering the loaded array in the browser; the chosen kind survives the 30s auto-refresh; no literal from the ten kind names appears in the page source
